title: APME Health Contract (additive, N37)
description: Machine-readable alias map between Gateway GET /api/v1/health fields and CLI apme health-check --json names. Gateway field names are unchanged (ADR-060 additive-only).

shape.detail: components[].detail (string|null) is additive per ADR-060 — set only for Galaxy Proxy config-push freshness, null otherwise — and is preserved verbatim (no dict restructuring) by the alias map.

notes: Gateway response shape is additive-only (ADR-060); components[].detail is the additive field (unchanged=false) and is preserved verbatim.
CLI --json nests Engine aggregate health as {engine: {status, address}, <service>: {status, address}}.
submit_token (N19 idempotency token from POST /approve, or client Idempotency-Key) is additive and covered: present only when issued, absent otherwise — clients must not require it.
pr_url is null until a PR exists: a null .pr_url in a submit/operate snapshot means no PR was recorded — check error/submit_error and status before treating null as failure.
Read-only venv view: GET /api/v1/sessions/venvs/{id} returns hash/requirements/age (Engine-owned venvs, read-only). age_seconds is session dwell (last_seen minus first_seen), not wall-clock age.
